From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordinating Discovery: deep-dive + compliance attendees

Hi Ava — great to meet you on the call last week. Thanks again for the time.

StellarNet sounded like a great fit for a short discovery to align on architecture, requirements, and procurement timeline before we schedule the technical demo. To make sure we have the right folks on the call, I propose we include:
- Your engineering lead for architecture & latency constraints (I saw Ravi on the thread)
- Your security/contact for compliance questions (SOC2 / data handling)
- Our SE (Sergio) to cover integration patterns and deployment options
- Monica (CS) to capture success criteria and timelines

Proposed 60-minute slots (PT):
• Tue Jun 16 — 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
• Wed Jun 17 — 09:00–10:00 or 13:00–14:00

If none of those work, tell us two windows that suit your team and we’ll sync calendars. Agenda I’d like to cover: kickoff/context, architecture questions, compliance checklist, success metrics, next steps. I’ll attach a short agenda and requirements checklist once we lock a time.

Thanks — looping in Sergio (SE) and Monica (CS). Markus is on copy for any early commercial/contract questions.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordinating Discovery: deep-dive + compliance attendees

Hi Karthik — thanks for the note and the suggested slots. I brought Ravi (engineering lead) into the thread and looped in our procurement and security mailboxes so they can confirm availability.

We can do Wed Jun 17 09:00–10:00 PT — that time works for Ravi and I. Procurement indicated they prefer to be on an initial alignment call but may only attend part of the time. Security asked if we can share SOC2 / encryption details in advance. Can you attach a SOC2 summary and a short list of security artifacts you typically provide?

Also — could you include a short agenda in the calendar invite and call out any decisions we should be prepared to make (e.g., target go-live window, expected throughput)? That will help us have the right people on.

A quick note on attendees: Ravi will bring one of our backend engineers for latency questions (TBD). Procurement will likely send a delegate (procurement@stellarnet.com) and security will join for the first 30 minutes.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Ava Thornton
Product Manager / Champion | StellarNet
ava.thornton@stellarnet.com
